children: Take-Two Interactive Software said Grand Theft Auto VI generated an estimated $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, setting a record for entertainment across any medium.
GTA VI's estimated $3.79 billion in worldwide day-one retail sales made it the biggest entertainment launch in history.
The game sold 32.5 million units pre-release, which Rockstar said was a record across all platforms.
GTA VI received a 99 Metacritic score and was described as the highest-rated game of all time.
The game is available through major digital stores and global retailers.
